ModMetaData.name: RandomPlus (Optimized)
ModMetaData.author: mastertea, GOTHENBERG
ModMetaData.description:
Allow users to set minimum specifications for pawn generation when using the randomize button. It will keep rerolling until the minimum specification is met or it passes the max reroll limit.
RandomPlus Optimized Edition for RimWorld 1.6: - Zero-allocation hot loops (no GC pauses during heavy rerolls). - Compiled reflection delegates for native C# execution speed. - Native TraitSet trait matching. - Deferred apparel and equipment generation. - Bounded health loops.
Original mod by mastertea, modernized and optimized by GOTHENBERG.
